relationships.subject: Topical insulin
relationships.evidence_quote: Our results showed that the pain level and scar healing in study group were lower than those in the control group after treatment, suggesting that external use of insulin had a good effect on relieving pain and scar healing in patients with diabetes of different depths.

key_findings: Topical insulin shortened burn wound healing time and reduced pain in diabetic burn patients.
Insulin group had lower IL-1, TNF-α, MDA and higher VEGF and SOD after treatment.
